figures.finding: Full-time actors in Poland's public theatres are paid the national minimum wage as base salary, their manifesto said in February 2025 (protest at the Silesian Theatre, Katowice, with the local branch of ZASP).
figures.applies: Poland, full-time actors in public theatres, as reported 13 Feb 2025.

sources.said: He delivered the manifesto on behalf of the theater's actors and the local branch of the Union of Polish Stage Artists. The document calls on full-time actors at Poland’s public theaters to unite against salaries that amount to the country’s minimum wage.

figures.finding: Polish is the official language of Poland.
figures.applies: All of Poland (Constitution, art. 27); the source states the official language, not the casting language as such.
